newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fong's says rights issue undersubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Fong's says rights issue undersubscribed.

text.p: Fong's Industries Co Ltd said in a statement published on Tuesday its proposed issue of 122.29 million rights shares were 54.7 percent subscribed.
The company said its controlling shareholders had been called upon to subscribe for the remaining 55.42 million rights shares, representing 11.3 percent of the expanded share capital.

In July, Fong's Industries proposed the rights issue in the proportion of one for every three existing shares at HK$0.35 per rights share, raising HK$42.8 million for general working capital including repayment of short term bank borrowings.
